meta.scope: Q2 (D4 + colour views, with colour-off control), Q3 (K=4096 teacher-key queue), Q4 gate, ViT-L/14 feasibility. Track A only. Seeds 42/43/44.
meta.status: IN PROGRESS. Predeclaration written before seeds 43/44 were launched; numbers below are filled from readouts only.

predeclaration.disclosure: Seed-42 readouts of all arms were reviewed by coordinator before this predeclaration was written. Seed 42 therefore cannot confirm the queue arm; it only selected it. The confirmatory test is seeds 43 and 44, which had no readouts when this was written.
predeclaration.arm: queue4096 (Q3): MoCo key queue K=4096 of teacher keys, FIFO, both views enqueued, symmetric InfoNCE over in-batch + queue negatives. Otherwise quota4 recipe, 6000 steps, batch 16, T=0.2, momentum 0.99.
predeclaration.success_rule: Success if the macro-F1 delta (arm minus fresh same-environment baseline) has the same positive sign in seeds 42, 43 and 44 on at least one dataset, AND the other dataset does not worsen by more than 0.01 macro-F1 in those seeds.
predeclaration.failure_rule: Anything else is not success. Other checkpoints (2000, 4000) and other arms are reported as descriptive only.
predeclaration.not_run: No further arms; d4_color, d4_only and SDCLR are closed as neutral or negative. No seeds beyond 42/43/44.

queue4096_s42.note: reported by coordinator: only arm with signal on s42 (448 D4 HAM +0.017 at all three ckpts; PAD 224 +0.018 at ck2000 and decaying to HAM 224 -0.023 at ck6000)

findings.HAM_source_fit: 2693 images with a same-lesion partner in the pool (1173 lesions, 1916 pairs). Uses HAM10000 lesion_id on the 6221 pool images that are in ham_fit. Not a dummy grouping; a real lesion key.
findings.PAD_pad_adapt: 377 images with a partner (173 lesions, 247 pairs). Matches coordinator count.

q4_gate.caveat: Pre-declared threshold of 200 images per dataset was arbitrary; coordinator used a ~1% noise criterion. Lesion purity audit not done (needs diagnosis, not allowed in this gate).

vit_l_feasibility.weights: dinov2_vitl14_pretrain.pth downloadable from dl.fbaipublicfiles.com from the cluster (HTTP 200, 1,217,586,395 bytes); not in torch hub cache
vit_l_feasibility.code_changes: EMBED_DIM=768 and HEAD sizes are fixed in moco_v3_20261029_helpers.py; the runtime, heads, feature script (ops.PUBLIC, get_intermediate_layers) and checks all assume ViT-B. ViT-L needs embed_dim 1024 and a 24-block freeze plan (freeze_blocks=20 for 'last 4 trainable').
vit_l_feasibility.vram_estimate: not measured. Weights bf16 about 0.6 GB; fp32 teacher copy 1.2 GB; trainable last 4 blocks ~50M parameters with AdamW state; activations for batch 16 x 2 views at 257 tokens. Expected to fit under ~10 GB, unverified.
vit_l_feasibility.compute: ~3.5x ViT-B per step (estimate, not timed). ViT-B run took 0.45 h wall for 6000 steps, so ViT-L is roughly 1.5-2 h per seed.
vit_l_feasibility.recommendation: Only after queue4096 s43/s44 are decided; it changes the backbone, so it is a new base and not an arm of this comparison.
